hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info>=(3,9) else 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1 && python -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info>=(3,9) else 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else echo "Python 3 fehlt (oder zu alt) — Logging und der Regel-Abgleich funktionieren nicht."; fi; exit 0

S="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/sync-rules.py"; if [ -f "$S" ]; then P=""; for c in python3 python; do "$c" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info>=(3,9) else 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1 && { P="$c"; break; }; done; [ -n "$P" ] && "$P" "$S" --check --quiet; fi; true
